::: {#exm-residual-prediction-error}
#### Residuals and prediction errors for birth weights

The `birthwt` data record the birth weight (grams) of `r nrow(read.csv("data/birthwt.csv"))` babies
and their mothers' weight at the last menstrual period (pounds),
from a study at Baystate Medical Center in Springfield, Massachusetts
[@hosmer1989applied].
They ship with the R package [`MASS`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=MASS)
(`MASS::birthwt`),
and this repository holds a copy at `data/birthwt.csv`.

The code below fits a line predicting birth weight from mother's weight,
then compares each residual with the negative of its prediction error.

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

##### R

```{r}
#| label: residual-prediction-error
#| code-fold: false
birthwt <- read.csv("data/birthwt.csv")
fit <- lm(bwt ~ lwt, data = birthwt)
fitted_bwt <- fitted(fit)
residual <- birthwt$bwt - fitted_bwt
prediction_error <- fitted_bwt - birthwt$bwt
head(data.frame(
  bwt = birthwt$bwt,
  fitted = round(fitted_bwt, 1),
  residual = round(residual, 1),
  minus_prediction_error = round(-prediction_error, 1)
))
max(abs(residual - (-prediction_error)))
```

##### Python

```{python}
#| label: residual-prediction-error-py
#| code-fold: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

birthwt = pd.read_csv("data/birthwt.csv")
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(birthwt)), birthwt["lwt"]])
y = birthwt["bwt"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
coef = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]
fitted_bwt = X @ coef
residual = y - fitted_bwt
prediction_error = fitted_bwt - y
print(pd.DataFrame({
    "bwt": y,
    "fitted": fitted_bwt.round(1),
    "residual": residual.round(1),
    "minus_prediction_error": (-prediction_error).round(1),
}).head())
print(np.max(np.abs(residual - (-prediction_error))))
```

:::

The last two columns agree in every row,
and the largest difference between them over all
`r nrow(birthwt)` babies is `r max(abs(residual - (-prediction_error)))`,
as @cor-residual-prediction-error says.
:::
